description: Copies one tab of a Google Sheets spreadsheet into another spreadsheet. Takes the source spreadsheet ID, the title of the tab to copy and the destination spreadsheet ID. The copy carries the tab's values, formulas and formatting and is added to the destination as a new tab, which Google names "Copy of <title>"; nothing already in the destination is changed, and the source is left as it was. Returns the new tab's sheetId, title and position in the destination. The account needs edit access to the destination.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

destination_spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet the copy is added to

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet that holds the tab to copy

title.description: Title of the tab to copy, as sheets_get_metadata lists it

name: gws-mcp__sheets_copy_tab_to
